description: This file defines the `HistoryRepository` class which provides data access methods for managing watch history records in a database, including listing history for a user, retrieving history for a specific user and video, and upserting progress.

classes.name: HistoryRepository
classes.description: Provides database access methods for watch history, allowing listing, retrieval, and updating watch progress.

methods.name: None __init__(self, db: Session)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the repository with a database session.

methods.name: list[WatchHistory] list_for_user(self, user_id: int)
methods.description: Returns a list of watch history entries for a specific user, ordered by most recent update.

methods.name: WatchHistory|None get_for_user_and_video(self, user_id: int, video_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves the watch history entry for a specific user and video, if exists.

methods.name: WatchHistory upsert_progress(self, user_id: int, video_id: int, progress_seconds: int)
methods.description: Creates a new watch history entry or updates an existing one with new progress.
